fixed_discount_badge.heading: Fixed discount badge
fixed_discount_badge.collection_info: Only products in this collection show the badge. Leave empty to hide it.
fixed_discount_badge.info: Displays a promotional label only; does not change prices.
fixed_discount_badge.rules_info: Set the collections and percentages here. These rules are shared by product cards and product details. The first matching rule wins. Empty collections are ignored. Labels do not change prices.
fixed_discount_badge.shared_info: Configure collections and percentages in Theme settings → Collection discount badges.

collection_notice.heading: Product notices by collection
collection_notice.info: Shown only on product pages, below the price. The first matching rule with text is used. Empty collections or messages are ignored.
collection_notice.secondary_message_info: Optional. Appears below the main message.
